purpose: Replace the invalidated monolithic 64-security execution transaction with deterministic resumable execution chunks without changing the frozen scientific Batch-1 design.

parent_batch.membership_rule: first 64 securities in the frozen SHA256(canonical_security_id), canonical_security_id order

execution_chunking.chunk_membership: contiguous rank ranges 1-8,9-16,...,57-64 of the unchanged frozen Batch-1 order

aggregation.terminal_rules: Use the unchanged frozen V2.9.1 Batch-1 technical checks and positive-state rule only after complete 64-security aggregation.

execution_governance.external_observability: GitHub matrix job status exposes chunk completion independently.
execution_governance.persistence: Each completed chunk commits its evidence to the repository before another chunk is scientifically necessary.
